wopl.title: Welcome to note it.
wopl.content:
Collaborative Real-Time Notepad

This is a live note accessible at /wopl on any connected domain. You can open this exact link from your phone, laptop, or any other browser window to see live real-time synchronization in action!

  • ✏️ Format text with bold, italics, headings, checklists
  • 🖼️ Paste or upload images seamlessly
  • 🔒 Protect sensitive notes with a password
  • ⚡ Instant 4-letter shareable URLs

Start typing or delete this text to test!
